title: Keep the default Core embedding port wired to the Commercial bus plug
goal: Make the existing bus-only local embedding provider available in the lean default susi-gmcp build so an attached Commercial gpu_fabric.embed.texts plug can serve embeddings without enabling tools-rich or moving the embedding engine into Core.

results.change: The existing bus-only embed_provider module is now compiled in the default susi-gmcp build; tools-rich remains optional and the BGE engine remains Commercial-only.
results.focused: cargo test --offline --locked -p susi-gmcp --lib: 219 passed, 0 failed; cargo test --offline --locked -p susi-gmcp --features tools-rich --lib embed_provider: 6 passed, 0 failed
results.format: cargo fmt --all --check and git diff --check: passed
results.clippy: cargo clippy --offline --locked -p susi-gmcp --all-targets -- -D warnings and the same command with --features tools-rich: passed
results.guards: cargo test --offline --locked -p susi --test lean_core_ceilings: 2 passed, 0 failed; cargo test --offline --locked -p susi --test task_records: 3 passed, 0 failed; susi-gmcp 25847/25860 shipped Rust lines
results.boundary: Core bus contract only; the BGE embedding engine remains in susi-commercial-apps. No Minijinja, dependency, release, harvest or credential change.
